dedupe_keys.name: ashp tes air source heat pump integrated with thermal storage simulation library

description: The ASHP_TES author publishes a Python simulation library for air-source heat pumps coupled to thermal energy storage. Zenodo archives a beta release under MIT and links a public repository. The README describes classes for heat-pump performance, evaporator and condenser heat exchangers, storage energy balance, building thermal load and climate import, with a main programme for hourly simulations over a year. This model can test sizing and operating choices for building heating and cooling infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this library. Coverage is user-supplied equipment and building parameters, not measured performance of a named heat-pump installation. A limitation is that a simple storage balance and chosen performance curves may miss stratification, cycling losses or local control details; the source article provides the physical formulation. The archived version is labelled beta. Neither package nor weather inputs were downloaded, and no annual energy result was reproduced.
